service.description: The framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider) over an owner whose service keeps its own shape, by the provider key its registration names: accounting.setup (Mantle's setup readiness, for a holder of ACCOUNTING_VIEW), products.catalogChecks (the catalog checks, PRODUCT_CATALOG_VIEW), commerce.storeReadiness (each store: its findings for a Commerce reader, its summary otherwise) and constitution.organization (whether an organization's own Constitution is valid). Each owner's service is called as the viewer for the organizations the viewer administers (none for a caller without the Admin root), or the one named, refused outside that scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); a check carries its organization or store as subject and scope and, where it has one, the key of its fix place. An organization the owner refuses the viewer is left out; one that fails is shown unavailable (PROVIDER_FAILED) and the others go on. Refuses an unknown key.

For each path under /qapps (a BOSS screen path or a framework app's route, with or without a query), whether it opens to the viewer's own groups, as the framework decides a screen path (Admin.js destinationOpens). Admin's own screens ask it for the places a registration's key resolves to under Admin's mount, so a fix link, a health card's link and Health's link are shown only where they open (template/AdminRegistry.js). It answers nothing but the caller's own access.
